content.about: Saint Kitts and Nevis is the smallest country in the Americas. Its two volcanic islands have rainforest and beaches. Brimstone Hill fort is a UNESCO site. Green vervet monkeys live there.

standout.text: Brimstone Hill Fortress is one of the best-preserved fortresses in the Americas.

didYouKnow: It is the smallest country in the Western Hemisphere.
Alexander Hamilton was born on Nevis.
Its scenic railway once carried sugar cane.
